INCIDENT TYPE:
API ABUSE

DESCRIPTION:
API abuse occurs when attackers exploit legitimate API functionality to perform unauthorized actions, scrape data, bypass business logic, or consume excessive resources.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1190 | Exploit Public-Facing Application

INDICATORS:
- Excessive API requests
- Abnormal API usage patterns
- Unauthorized data access
- Token misuse
- Rate limit violations

DETECTION RULES:
- High request volumes
- Unusual endpoint access
- Token abuse

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- APIs
- Databases
- Mobile applications
title: API ABUSE
